sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our order history for this part shows 28.94 EUR (po:4500010017-10) against 29.89 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014436-10).
Our running contract ctr:4600070410 is valid until 2027-06-30 and fixes delivery at 42 days (ctr:4600070410#5.1).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Your historical data is noted, and we accept the volume of 23,400 pieces over 24 months. We do not provide internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our Angebot is a price of €33.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.50 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have verified your volume forecast data and taken it into account. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can adjust our price to €33.20 per unit for the requested 42-day lead time. Further concessions on this basis are not possible.

For this volume of 23400 pcs per year, our Angebot provides a price of €33.20 per unit, a Lieferzeit 42 days, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We note your acceptance of the alternative package with an adjustment to a 56-day lead time. 

For clarity, our Angebot stands at a price of €31.50 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a Lieferzeit 56 days, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer remains valid for 14 days. We look forward to your final confirmation to conclude this agreement.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
